address: 160 Great Portland Street, London, W1W 5QA, United Kingdom
bio: Adding to London’s status as a truly great city for international dining is this slickly decorated restaurant offering the flavours of Chile, where the rocks and marble decorating the sultry room all come from the country. The large open kitchen adds to the animation and dinner is when the place comes alive, although if you come at lunch you’ll benefit from a good value menu. Highlights could include the choice of empanadas to begin or the flan to finish; throughout your meal, accompany it with the exclusively Chilean wine list.
